entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • AnalyzeDataFlow should succeed when the region is the receiver of an instance method call #86099
  • `dotnet format whitespace` leaves documentation comment lines that IDE0055 reports (tabs vs. spaces at the same column) #86097
  • C# compiler should number the anonymous delegate types of lambdas with optional or params parameters the same in every build #86096

Closed

  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-12316.87 #86098
  • `ref var x = ref y;` inferred type does not keep correct nullability #86095

PullRequests

Created

  • Enter and leave analysis regions for receiver calls in a call chain #86100
    Community
  • Fix auto-generation of project data schema properties file #86094

Updated

  • Avoid revisiting directories through symlinks in file-based app discovery #86091
    Community, VSCode
  • Fix CS8618 suggesting 'required' on events #82424
    Area-Compilers, Community, VSCode
